readerCopy.headline: Let yourself enjoy what is working.
readerCopy.body:
A connection may feel less complicated. Plans come together without endless rescheduling. A creative choice gets a warm response. You may simply have more chances to enjoy yourself without needing every pleasant moment to prove something about the future.

Jupiter trine Venus can make the good part easy to trust. Take the win. Just remember that every easy yes still takes an evening, a dollar, or some part of your attention. Pleasure works better when it does not leave the rest of the week paying for it.
